topic: Access and communication setup for design team
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on granting the designer access to internal systems and establishing a dedicated communication channel. [me] confirmed that an existing login could be provided for sandbox testing, with the link shared. It was agreed that adding the designer to Google Chat would be beneficial during campaign development to facilitate quick communication regarding potential questions.

A specific name for the new chat was decided: "Бразилия Design" (Brazil Design), using Cyrillic characters for clarity.
decisions: The designer will receive access credentials for the sandbox analytics system.
A dedicated Google Chat space named 'Бразилия Design' will be created for the design team.
action_items: Send the designer an invitation to the new Google Chat space.
